note: Des Moines County Conservation campground ~10 mi N of Burlington, on the 178-acre Big Hollow Lake complex. RV pads sit in an open, partly shaded clearing above the lake with woods between (about 170 m to the shore); nearby water is small ponds. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25-30, full hookup, year-round, 14 max, 66 sites; added 50 amp, facilities, minimums, year-ahead window, wifi. Not waterfront stands on the lake; pond lead for three sites.
flags: WATERFRONT: Big Hollow Lake, not waterfront stands: nearest pad (site 16-18 row, also the 20-24 row) is about 170 m of forest above the shore, with no view on imagery. Campground map confirms the lake is off to the south, reached by trails. LEAD (pond, small): sites on the west side of the loop road (8, 9, 11, per the county's campground map) back onto a roughly 1.4-acre pond: about 40-50 m of open mowed grass, no road between (the loop road is on their east side). Under 5 acres, so pond, and the apron is open; 'pond' fits those sites only. Sites on the other side of the road don't count; the pond is across the road from them. Electric sites 116-118 also sit near a pond on the map, but that loop is not on the imagery I read, so I can't measure it.

IMAGERY: the electric loop (101-118, on the map west of the pond) doesn't appear on current Esri imagery, so it's newer than the image. Pin fine: about 90 m from the centre of the RV loops. No closure found.
